svg.text: One straight route. Two combat pockets. Quieter lobby, denser team bays.
S Standing desks use props only.
1 Values wheel · Reception logo: OUR VALUES spin forever.
2 Printer station · PC LOAD LETTER and an avalanche of pages.
3 Ping-pong · Score stuck at 1–1 since Tuesday.
4 Office tree · LOW HANGING FRUIT, one leaf left.
5 Whiteboard · Q4 goals, copied from Q3.
a Cooler chat · Two people catch up at the water cooler.
b Printer jam · One person coaxes the jammed printer.
c Phone loop · A phone call paces inside a side bay.
d Mug walker · A mug carrier follows the dotted aisle trace.
Chairs, worktops and partitions are separate layers. Solid footprints are measured at the floor.
